title: Inputs and component boundaries
paragraphs: Input: Free v5.01 ISO, stock Grasslands, Iris model 0, frozen NED route. No policy weights or real reconstruction.
Python sends setpoints to PX4. CopterSim advances dynamics. PX4 returns estimates and mode/arm ACKs.
UE4 renders the camera. A separate receiver saves images and raw camera/body metadata. Calibrated association is still missing.

title: Capture comparison stays limited
paragraphs: Mean setpoint interval: 100.022 ms without capture, 100.034 ms with capture.
Maximum tick lateness: 12 ms versus 16 ms. Neither run had a tick more than 100 ms late. State gaps peaked at 125 ms and 110 ms.
Cleanup workers hit 15 s despite confirmation summaries. Raw cleanup logs are empty. Queue repair needs retesting.

title: Camera geometry exposed our defect
paragraphs: A1 and A2 saved 260 and 261 frames. A1 captured 25.797 seconds, short of the requested 26.
Our adapter converted degrees to radians for a degree field. The intended 15° yaw and 10° pitch were not executed.
Local duration and degree fixes passed helper tests. They need a simulator retest. Pose repeatability and projection checks remain blocked.

title: Native capture meets the rate request
paragraphs: The 35 s test included 5 s warmup and 300 post-warmup frames. Delivered record rate was 10.013 Hz.
No duplicate native timestamps or post-warmup receipt gaps above 150 ms occurred in the saved rate sequence.
A2 first image had an old-looking clock value before a large jump. Clock ownership and acquisition latency remain unresolved.

title: Reconstruction and Gaussian boundaries
paragraphs: Real photos plus calibrated poses: no verified direct reconstruction loader. Cooked UE mesh/XML import is documented, with Free eligibility unresolved.
External trajectory replay: a conditional small adapter after camera calibration, with an existing Gaussian scene and renderer.
Native RGB replacement or a visual closed loop: unresolved supported contract and substantial integration. Collision/depth and clock ownership need separate services.

title: Scoped R4R decision
paragraphs: Reuse as a dynamics/control host and keep a native RGB baseline for integration experiments.
Defer calibrated replay and R4R reconstruction rendering until corrected rotations, projection/extrinsics and acquisition timing are verified.
Indoor navigation, residential/campus views below 100 m, sparse capture and racing remain research questions. C is blocked by missing compatible released weights and task adapter.
